clauses.mechanism: express revocation by name in Sec. 7 of EO 11562 (no effective-date wording; read as on signing)
clauses.reason: whole: EO 11492 (signed 1969-10-30, 34 FR 17721) amends Sec. 3(a) of EO 11398 by substituting a new subsection that establishes the Citizens Advisory Committee on Physical Fitness and Sports; its only command is that substitution, and it has no own-terms end. First end: EO 11562 (signed 1970-09-25, 35 FR 15063), whose Sec. 7 reads "S ec. 7. Revocations." and, on the following lines, "and Executive Order No. 11492 of October 30,1969, are hereby revoked." (the sentence names EO 11398 and EO 11492 by number). EO 11562 has no effective-date wording, so the revocation is read as effective on signing, 1970-09-25 (the FR filing date, 1970-09-28, is not used). The OFR catalog note on the target reads "Revoked by: EO 11562, September 25, 1970". The amended parent EO 11398 is revoked by the same sentence, so the amendment and its parent end on the same date. Sec. 6 of EO 11562 continues the Committee's function under the new Council: see the savings entry.

research_rationale:
EO 11492 (signed 1969-10-30, 34 FR 17721) read in full from the held official FR text, and EO 11562 (1970-09-25, 35 FR 15063) read in full from the held FR text. Identity confirmed by number, date and subject. First and whole-order end: express revocation by name in Sec. 7 of EO 11562, effective on signing (no effective-date wording). The dossier carries five ACT leads for this pair from several copies of EO 11562 (the FR copy, the APP mirror and a clause-drafts copy); I used the FR copy only. Sec. 6 of EO 11562 deems the new Council a continuation of the Committee, which is a transfer of the function rather than a survival of EO 11492: savings state transferred_or_accrued. AI producer hypothesis only; not human certification.

savings.reason: EO 11562 (held FR text) Sec. 6 reads "S ec. 6. C ontinuity, (a) The Council established by this order shall" followed on the next lines by "be deemed to be a continuation of the Citizens Advisory Committee" which has heretofore existed under EO 11398 as amended. Sec. 7 revokes EO 11398 and EO 11492 by number. The Committee's function continues under the Council; EO 11492 itself has no residual command.
